title.en: Tate brothers arrested in US as further UK charges take total to 59
title.zh: 安德鲁·泰特及其兄弟在美国被捕，此前英国对他们提出了更多指控

summary.en: Andrew Tate and his brother have been arrested in the US following new charges laid against them in the UK. The Crown Prosecution Service has requested their extradition from the US, while their lawyer maintains their innocence.
summary.zh: 安德鲁·泰特及其兄弟在美国被捕，此前英国对他们提出了更多指控。英国皇家检察署已要求将他们从美国引渡，而他们的律师则坚称他们无罪。

body.en:
Controversial influencer Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan have been arrested in the US after British authorities issued 38 new charges against the pair.

The UK's Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) said Andrew was being charged with seven further counts of rape, as well as charges relating to sex trafficking and indecent images of a child.

Tristan's charges include two counts of rape and three counts of arranging or facilitating trafficking for sexual exploitation.

The total number of charges against the brothers is now 59, Bedfordshire and Hertfordshire police said.

The alleged offending is said to have taken place between July 2010 and August 2017. The Tates have previously denied any wrongdoing.

"These charging decisions followed receipt of a further file of evidence from Bedfordshire Police and bring the total number of alleged victims in this case to seven," Malcolm McHaffie, Head of the Special Crime Division at the Crown Prosecution Service, said.

Bedfordshire and Hertfordshire police have been investigating a number of offences in what it called a "complex investigation".

As a result, 38 new charges were authorised against the brothers, meaning there are now a total of 42 charges against Andrew and 17 against Tristan.

The US Marshals confirmed to the BBC that the Tates had been taken into custody, while a US Department of Justice spokesperson said the arrests were "pursuant to extradition proceedings".

The CPS said in its statement it has requested the extradition of the brothers, who are dual British-US citizens, from the US.

A lawyer who represents the Tates, Joseph McBride, said "the world knows Andrew and Tristan are innocent" in a statement released after their arrest on Saturday evening.

"Their enemies know it best of all. That is exactly why they have been attacked," McBride continued, describing the new UK charges as a "political hit".

He said the new charges were designed to counter a defamation action filed by the brothers in the US.

"We are confident that once a competent judge sees the facts, and once the Department of Justice confronts this egregious abuse of its own authority, Andrew and Tristan Tate will walk free. America does not do Britain's political dirty work," he continued.

In May 2025, prosecutors confirmed a list of 21 charges Andrew Tate, 39, and Tristan Tate, 37, will eventually face in the UK.

In 2024, Bedfordshire Police secured European arrest warrants for the pair to have them returned from Romania, where they are based and are under criminal investigation.

In June, the brothers lost a legal bid to be told the names of their UK accusers , after the CPS decided it was necessary to withhold the names of their alleged victims until legal action formally started.
body.zh: 在英国当局宣布对他们提出进一步指控后，有争议的影响者安德鲁·泰特和他的兄弟特里斯坦在美国被捕。 英国皇家检察署（CPS）表示，安德鲁·泰特还被指控犯有七项强奸罪，以及与性交易和儿童不雅图像等涉嫌犯罪相关的其他指控。 特里斯坦·塔特被指控犯有一项性侵犯罪、两项强奸罪和三项安排或协助贩运人口以进行性剥削的罪名。 据称，所指控的犯罪行为发生在 2010 年 7 月至 2017 年 8 月期间。泰特夫妇此前否认有任何不当行为。 皇家检察署特别犯罪部门负责人马尔科姆·麦克哈菲表示：“这些指控决定是在收到贝德福德郡警方提供的进一步证据后做出的，这使得本案的受害者总数达到七人。” 美国法警向英国广播公司证实，泰茨夫妇已被拘留，而美国司法部发言人表示，逮捕行动是“根据引渡程序”进行的。 CPS 在声明中表示，已要求从美国引渡这对具有英美双重公民的兄弟。 泰茨夫妇的代表律师约瑟​​夫·麦克布莱德在周六晚被捕后发表的一份声明中表示，“全世界都知道安德鲁和特里斯坦是无辜的”。 麦克布莱德继续说道：“他们的敌人最清楚这一点。这正是他们受到攻击的原因。”他将英国的新指控描述为“政治打击”。 他说，新指控旨在反击兄弟俩在美国提起的诽谤诉讼。 “我们相信，一旦有能力的法官看清事实，一旦司法部面对这种严重滥用其权力的行为，安德鲁和特里斯坦·泰特就会逍遥法外。美国不会做英国的政治肮脏工作，”他继续说道。 2025 年 5 月，检察官确认了 39 岁的安德鲁·泰特 (Andrew Tate) 和 37 岁的特里斯坦·泰特 (Tristan Tate) 最终将在英国面临的 21 项指控清单。 2024 年，贝德福德郡警方向这对夫妇发出了欧洲逮捕令，将他们从罗马尼亚遣返，他们目前正在罗马尼亚接受刑事调查。 六月，在英国皇家检察署决定在正式开始法律行动之前有必要隐瞒其所谓受害者的姓名后，兄弟俩输掉了要求获知英国原告姓名的法律诉讼。

reflection.en: In legal matters, it is crucial to hear all sides before forming a judgment. While charges have been laid, the legal process allows for defense and examination, reminding us that initial accusations are not the final word. Yahweh's wisdom encourages us to listen carefully and not rush to conclusions.
reflection.zh: 在法律事务中，在做出判断之前倾听各方意见至关重要。虽然指控已经提出，但法律程序允许辩护和审查，提醒我们最初的指控并非最终定论。雅伟的智慧鼓励我们仔细聆听，不要急于下结论。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Middle East crisis live: US launches new round of airstrikes to ‘swiftly punish’ Iran after American troops killed
title.zh: 中东危机实时报道：美国在美军遇袭身亡后发动新一轮空袭，‘迅速惩罚’伊朗

summary.en: The United States has launched new airstrikes in the Middle East, described as a swift punishment for Iran, following an attack that killed two American troops and left one missing in Jordan. This fresh round of attacks comes after Iran's supreme leader warned Washington of repercussions for escalating the conflict.
summary.zh: 在美国驻约旦部队遭遇袭击，造成两名美军死亡、一人失踪后，美国在中东发动了新一轮空袭，称此举旨在迅速惩罚伊朗。此次新的袭击发生前，伊朗最高领袖曾警告华盛顿，若升级冲突将付出代价。

body.en: Fresh attack comes after Iran’s supreme leader warned Washington would pay for ‘seeking to escalate’ the conflict Two US troops killed and one missing in Jordan after Iranian attacks We reported in an earlier post that sirens had been activated in Bahrain, which hosts a US naval base and has been targeted by Iran in recent days. A journalist from the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency has confirmed sirens had rung out in Bahrain’s capital Manama. We will bring you more details as they come in. A frustrated US is exploring how to bend Iran to its will, after Trump described the country’s leaders as “scum” and “sick people” at this month’s Nato summit, though it is not obvious how that can be done without a substantial ground campaign, for which the US is not prepared for, nor has the appetite for. Military escalation was considered at a White House Situation Room meeting on Tuesday, followed by leaks that the options considered included bombing another deep-lying nuclear site at Pickaxe Mountain – which would have no effect on the now critical Hormuz dynamic – or a seizure of the strategic Kharg Island, through which 90% of Iran’s oil exports would flow if there was no US blockade. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在伊朗最高领导人警告华盛顿将为“寻求升级”冲突付出代价之后，又发生了新的袭击。伊朗袭击后，约旦有两名美军丧生，一人失踪。我们在早些时候的一篇文章中报道称，巴林已拉响警报，巴林拥有一个美国海军基地，最近几天已成为伊朗的袭击目标。法新社（AFP）通讯社的一名记者证实，巴林首都麦纳麦已拉响警报。我们将在他们到来时向您提供更多细节。在特朗普在本月的北约峰会上将伊朗领导人描述为“败类”和“病夫”之后，沮丧的美国正在探索如何让伊朗屈服于其意愿，尽管目前尚不清楚如何在不进行大规模地面行动的情况下实现这一目标，而美国对此没有做好准备，也没有兴趣。周二的白宫战情室会议考虑了军事升级，随后有消息称，考虑的选项包括轰炸镐山的另一个深层核设施——这对目前至关重要的霍尔木兹动态没有影响——或者夺取具有战略意义的哈格岛，如果没有美国的封锁，伊朗90%的石油出口将通过该岛进行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of escalating conflict and the desire for retribution, the human tendency is often to respond to evil with more evil. Yet, Yahweh's word calls us to a different path, urging us not to be overcome by evil, but to overcome evil with good. This principle reminds us that true strength lies in breaking cycles of harm, seeking ways that lead towards...
reflection.zh: 面对不断升级的冲突和报复的欲望，人类的倾向往往是以恶报恶。然而，雅伟的话语呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们不要被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。这一原则提醒我们，真正的力量在于打破伤害的循环，寻求通往和平而非进一步分裂的途径。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Ferry carrying 116 passengers sinks off Guyana coast, authorities say
title.zh: 当局称，载有116名乘客的渡轮在圭亚那海岸附近沉没

summary.en: Authorities report that a ferry carrying 116 passengers has sunk off the coast of Guyana, with eight passengers rescued so far after the vessel capsized between Georgetown and Port Kaituma.
summary.zh: 当局称，一艘载有116名乘客的渡轮在圭亚那海岸附近沉没，该船在乔治敦和凯图马港之间倾覆后，目前已有八名乘客获救。

body.en:
A ferry carrying 116 passengers has sunk off the coast of Guyana with eight people so far rescued, local authorities have said.

The MV Barima capsized near Iron Punt, on its route from Georgetown to Port Kaituma.

A distress call was received at 23:01 local time (03:01 +1 BST), triggering an urgent search operation involving state and private boats, Public Works Minister Juan Edghill said in a statement posted on social media.

The state of the operation is currently unclear and it is not known whether authorities expect to rescue the remaining passengers.

The MV Barima was built in 1939 and is 40m (131ft) long, according to a listing on VesselFinder.

Edghill said it was fitted with 250 life jackets, two rigid life crafts and six inflatable life crafts.
body.zh: 当地政府表示，一艘载有 116 名乘客的渡轮在圭亚那海岸沉没，目前已有 8 人获救。 MV Barima 在从乔治城到凯图马港的航线上在 Iron Punt 附近倾覆。 公共工程部长胡安·埃德吉尔在社交媒体上发布的一份声明中表示，当地时间 23:01（英国夏令时间 03:01 +1）收到求救信号，引发了涉及国有和私人船只的紧急搜索行动。 目前行动情况尚不清楚，也不知道当局是否希望营救剩余的乘客。 根据 VesselFinder 上的列表，MV Barima 建于 1939 年，长 40m（131 英尺）。 Edghill表示，船上配备了250件救生衣、两艘刚性救生艇和六艘充气救生艇。

reflection.en: The news of a capsized ferry and missing passengers brings profound sadness, reminding us of life's fragility and the suddenness of tragedy. In moments of deep grief and loss, we hold onto the promise that Yahweh will one day wipe away every tear, and death, mourning, crying, and pain will be no more. This hope anchors us even when the present reality is...
reflection.zh: 渡轮倾覆和乘客失踪的消息带来了深深的悲伤，提醒我们生命的脆弱和悲剧的突如其来。在深切的悲痛和失落时刻，我们紧紧抓住雅伟有一天将擦去所有眼泪的应许，那时死亡、悲哀、哭号和疼痛都将不再有。这份盼望在当下充满忧伤的现实中成为我们的锚。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Restoring Britain’s health to 2014 levels could add 2% to GDP, thinktank says
title.zh: 智库称将英国健康水平恢复到2014年可使GDP增长2%

summary.en: A thinktank report suggests that improving the health of the UK population to 2014 levels could increase the country's GDP by 2% and add £72 billion to public finances. The paper emphasizes that national health is a significant economic asset.
summary.zh: 一份智库报告指出，将英国人口健康水平恢复到2014年，可使国内生产总值（GDP）增长2%，并为公共财政带来720亿英镑的收益。该报告强调，国民健康是一项重要的经济资产。

body.en: Health Foundation paper argues health is an economic asset and improving it could generate £72bn for public finances Restoring the deteriorating health of the UK’s population to the level of 2014 would boost GDP by 2% and generate a £72bn dividend for the public finances, research suggests. A paper by the Health Foundation thinktank , published on Sunday, argues the nation’s health should be valued by policymakers as an economic asset. Continue reading...
body.zh: 健康基金会的论文认为，健康是一项经济资产，改善健康可以为公共财政带来 720 亿英镑的收入 研究表明，将英国人口日益恶化的健康状况恢复到 2014 年的水平将使 GDP 增长 2%，并为公共财政带来 720 亿英镑的红利。健康基金会智库周日发表的一篇论文认为，政策制定者应将国家健康视为一项经济资产。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report reminds us that a nation's health is not merely a social concern but a vital economic asset. Deuteronomy 8:18 highlights that Yahweh gives us the power to gain wealth, suggesting that foundational blessings like good health are integral to a society's ability to prosper. Investing in collective well-being is therefore an act of wise stewardship...
reflection.zh: 这份报告提醒我们，一个国家的健康不仅是社会关切，更是重要的经济资产。申命记8:18强调雅伟赐予我们获取财富的能力，这表明良好的健康等基础性福祉对于社会繁荣至关重要。因此，投资于集体福祉是一种明智的管家行为，能为所有人带来丰厚的回报。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: DWP brought in measures to tackle carer’s allowance scandal yet in 2025-26 there were 32,559 overpayments Scores of unpaid carers were hit with demands to repay sums of more than £20,000 and hundreds more put at risk of prosecution last year as a result of official failures in what appear to be continuing problems with carer’s allowance. New figures showed carers were asked to repay £33m in 2025-26 as a result of 32,559 earnings-related overpayments, despite the introduction of measures over a year ago designed specifically to prevent carers falling foul of the system. Continue reading...
body.zh: DWP 采取了解决看护者津贴丑闻的措施，但在 2025-26 年，有 32,559 名多付的看护者被要求偿还超过 20,000 英镑的欠款，去年，由于官方未能解决看护者津贴问题，还有数百人面临被起诉的风险。新数据显示，尽管一年多前出台了专门防止护理人员违反系统规定的措施，但由于 32,559 笔与收入相关的超额付款，护理人员在 2025-26 年度被要求偿还 3300 万英镑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to compassion for vulnerable people. Galatians 6:2 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with practical compassion and welcome, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到对脆弱群体的怜悯。Galatians 6:2提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以具体的怜悯与接纳来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Russia launches major ballistic missile attack on Kyiv
title.zh: 俄罗斯对基辅发动大规模弹道导弹袭击

summary.en: One death is reported in what President Zelensky calls "one of the most massive ballistic attacks" on Ukraine's capital.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Russia has carried out a wave of ballistic missile strikes on the Ukrainian capital Kyiv, killing one person and wounding at least 14, officials say.

A number of areas in the region were hit overnight. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky called it "one of the most massive ballistic attacks on Kyiv" since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion.

The Ukrainian military said air defences had shot down 18 out of 41 missiles. The systems also intercepted 108 drones.

Meanwhile Ukraine has continued its own assault on Russian sites. The governor of the south-western Stavropol region said a drone attack had caused a fire in an industrial park.

The latest strikes on Kyiv involved a range of Russian weapons systems, including Iskander and hypersonic Zircon missiles, as well as 125 drones, the Ukrainian air force said.

On Sunday Kyiv Mayor Vitaliy Klitschko said both residential and non-residential buildings had been damaged in the latest attacks, including a supermarket and a dormitory.

In his message on Telegram, Zelensky said in the past week Russia had "used about 1,450 strike drones, more than 1,640 guided bombs and 99 missiles of various types against Ukraine".

The overnight strikes came after Ukraine sent drones to destroy two warehouses belonging to Russia's biggest online retailer , Wildberries, killing eight people and causing major fires.

Seven deaths and 25 injuries occurred at a facility in the city of Tambov, about 295 miles (475km) south-east of Moscow. One death and 37 injuries occurred at another Wildberries warehouse in Elektrostal near the capital.

On Saturday, Zelensky said Ukraine's operations were in response to "Russian strikes on our civilian infrastructure and on our cities and communities".

Wildberries is often described as the Russian equivalent of Amazon. The RWB group, which combines Wildberries with advertising company Russ, was valued at about $12.6bn (£9.3bn) by Forbes Russia in 2026.

Ukraine has recently intensified its long-range drone attacks on Russia's critical energy infrastructure, causing widespread fuel shortages. Earlier this month, Kyiv said nearly 43% of Russia's oil refining capacity had been "disabled" as a result.

Ukraine says Russian oil and gas facilities are legitimate targets as Moscow relies heavily on fossil fuel exports to finance its full-scale invasion, which began in February 2022.
body.zh: 官员称，俄罗斯对乌克兰首都基辅发动了一波弹道导弹袭击，造成1人死亡、至少14人受伤。 该地区的许多地区一夜之间受到袭击。乌克兰总统泽伦斯基称这是自俄罗斯全面入侵以来“对基辅最大规模的弹道袭击之一”。 乌克兰军方表示，防空系统击落了 41 枚导弹中的 18 枚。该系统还拦截了 108 架无人机。 与此同时，乌克兰继续攻击俄罗斯网站。西南部斯塔夫罗波尔地区州长表示，无人机袭击导致工业园区起火。 乌克兰空军表示，最近对基辅的袭击涉及一系列俄罗斯武器系统，包括“伊斯坎德尔”和高超音速“锆石”导弹，以及 125 架无人机。 基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科周日表示，住宅和非住宅建筑在最近的袭击中均遭到破坏，其中包括一家超市和一间宿舍。 泽连斯基在 Telegram 上表示，过去一周，俄罗斯“对乌克兰使用了约 1,450 架无人机、超过 1,640 枚制导炸弹和 99 枚各类导弹”。 乌克兰出动无人机摧毁了俄罗斯最大在线零售商 Wildberry 的两个仓库，造成 8 人死亡并引发大火，之后发生了连夜袭击。 位于莫斯科东南约 295 英里（475 公里）的坦波夫市的一处设施发生 7 人死亡、25 人受伤。首都附近埃莱克特罗斯塔尔的另一个 Wildberry 仓库发生 1 人死亡、37 人受伤。 泽伦斯基周六表示，乌克兰的行动是为了回应“俄罗斯对我们的民用基础设施以及我们的城市和社区的袭击”。 野莓通常被描述为俄罗斯版的亚马逊。 RWB 集团由 Wildberry 和广告公司 Russ 合并而成，2026 年《福布斯》俄罗斯版对 RWB 的估值约为 126 亿美元（93 亿英镑）。 乌克兰最近加强了对俄罗斯关键能源基础设施的远程无人机攻击，导致广泛的燃料短缺。本月早些时候，基辅表示，俄罗斯近 43% 的炼油能力因此“瘫痪”。 乌克兰表示，俄罗斯石油和天然气设施是合法目标，因为莫斯科严重依赖化石燃料出口为其自 2022 年 2 月开始的全面入侵提供资金。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.

title.en: Russia pounds Kyiv for five hours in one of biggest ever ballistic missile attacks

summary.en: Russian forces launched one of their largest ballistic missile attacks on Kyiv, causing at least one death, fires, and damage to buildings. This major five-hour raid followed earlier Ukrainian strikes on logistics warehouses in Russia.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯军队对基辅发动了有史以来最大规模的弹道导弹袭击之一，造成至少一人死亡，并导致火灾和建筑物受损。这次长达五小时的大规模袭击发生在乌克兰军队早些时候袭击了俄罗斯境内的后勤仓库之后。

body.en: At least one person killed after dozens of missiles arrive in less than an hour and three-storey building catches fire Russia has carried out one of its biggest-ever ballistic missile attacks on Kyiv, launching a five-hour raid that left at least one person dead and seven injured, with fires and damage across the city. Ukrainian officials said the capital was hit with about 40 Iskander-M and hypersonic Zircon missiles. Residents heard an air raid siren sound at 1.30am. There was the sound of air defences, followed minutes later by a series of booms and explosions. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The news of escalating attacks, where one strike follows another, highlights the tragic cycle of retaliation that often defines conflict. In such moments, Yahweh's word reminds us not to be overcome by evil, but to seek ways to overcome evil with good.
reflection.zh: 袭击不断升级，一波未平一波又起，这凸显了冲突中常见的报复循环的悲剧。在这样的时刻，雅伟的话语提醒我们不要被恶所胜，而要寻求以善胜恶的方法。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Cuban dissident Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara goes into exile in US
title.zh: 古巴持不同政见者路易斯·曼努埃尔·奥特罗·阿尔坎塔拉流亡美国

summary.en: He was arrested in 2021 during Cuba's largest anti-government protests in decades and spent five years ⁠in prison.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
One of Cuba's most prominent dissidents has gone into exile in the US, after leaving Cuba where he had served a five-year prison sentence.

Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara, 38, is the leader of the San Isidro Movement (SIM), a group of artists, journalists and intellectuals who have campaigned for freedom of speech and democracy in the communist country.

He was arrested in 2021 during Cuba's largest anti-government protests in decades and spent five years ⁠in the maximum-security Guanajay prison near Havana.

His whereabouts have been unclear in recent days as Cuban authorities held him in an unknown location while the US approved a parole request.

Emerging from the airport in Miami, the 38-year-old was greeted by supporters who sang the Cuban national anthem as he held up his forefinger and thumb in the shape of the letter L to represent '"Libertad" - meaning freedom, a recognised anti-government symbol.

"I believe the dictatorship has to end, and the Castro dynasty has to end, as well," Otero Alcántara later told journalists. "Because as long as there is a Castro in power, there will be corruption."

Cuban authorities allege the SIM is funded by Washington and has been used to subvert the state, claims the movement denies. Many members say they have been constantly targeted by the security forces, and some arbitrarily detained.

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the Cuban government's "brutal crackdown against its own people five years ago is yet another reminder of the unique misery and evil that is innate to the communist system".

"Otero Alcántara's only 'crime' was refusing to stay silent and using his art to demand the basic freedoms everyday Cubans have been denied for almost seven decades," he said in a statement.

The cases of Otero Alcántara and ​fellow SIM member Maykel Castillo, known as "Osorbo", who is serving an eight-year prison sentence, have been a recurring source of diplomatic tension between Washington and Havana.

That tension has swelled in recent months , with the Trump administration hitting Cuba with an oil blockade, sanctions and openly threatening military intervention.

Last week the BBC's US news partner CBS reported that the Pentagon was looking at military options in Cuba, although it quoted officials as saying the briefings did not mean any decision to carry out an operation had been made.

The US oil blockade has exacerbated an ongoing fuel crisis , with Cubans facing extended blackouts and food shortages in recent months.

The US also announced in May an unprecedented murder indictment against former Cuban leader Raúl Castro, over the 1996 downing of two planes, an incident that killed four people. Russia and China condemned the move.

body.zh: 古巴最著名的持不同政见者之一在离开古巴并被判五年徒刑后流亡美国。 路易斯·曼努埃尔·奥特罗·阿尔坎塔拉 (Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara)，38 岁，是圣伊西德罗运动 (SIM) 的领导人，该运动由艺术家、记者和知识分子组成，致力于在共产主义国家争取言论自由和民主。 2021 年，他在古巴数十年来最大规模的反政府抗议活动中被捕，并在哈瓦那附近戒备森严的瓜纳哈伊监狱度过了五年。 最近几天，他的下落不明，古巴当局将他关押在一个未知地点，而美国则批准了假释请求。 这位38岁的球员从迈阿密机场走出来，受到了唱着古巴国歌的支持者的欢迎，他举起食指和拇指，形成字母L的形状，代表“Libertad”——意思是自由，是公认的反政府象征。 “我相信独裁统治必须结束，卡斯特罗王朝也必须结束，”奥特罗·阿尔坎塔拉后来告诉记者。 “因为只要有卡斯特罗掌权，就会有腐败。” 古巴当局声称 SIM 由华盛顿资助，并被用来颠覆国家，但该运动否认。许多成员表示，他们不断成为安全部队的攻击目标，有些人还被任意拘留。 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，古巴政府“五年前对本国人民的残酷镇压再次提醒我们共产主义制度固有的独特痛苦和邪恶”。 他在一份声明中说：“奥特罗·阿尔坎塔拉唯一的‘罪行’是拒绝保持沉默，并利用他的艺术要求古巴人每天都享有近七年来被剥夺的基本自由。” 奥特罗·阿尔坎塔拉（Otero Alcántara）和 SIM 成员梅克尔·卡斯蒂略（Maykel Castillo）（被称为“Osorbo”）正在服八年徒刑，他们的案件一直是华盛顿和哈瓦那之间外交紧张的根源。 近几个月来，随着特朗普政府对古巴实施石油封锁、制裁并公开威胁进行军事干预，这种紧张局势加剧。 上周，英国广播公司(BBC)的美国新闻合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司(CBS)报道称，五角大楼正在考虑在古巴采取军事行动的方案，不过该报道援引官员的话说，简报并不意味着已经做出了任何实施行动的决定。 美国的石油封锁加剧了持续存在的燃料危机，近几个月古巴人面临长期停电和粮食短缺。 美国还于 5 月宣布对前古巴领导人劳尔·卡斯特罗 (Raúl Castro) 提出史无前例的谋杀指控，指控他于 1996 年击落两架飞机，造成四人死亡。俄罗斯和中国谴责此举。 在美国的制裁中，旅游业受到了重大打击，人数少于...

The Victorian premier, Jacinta Allan, announced a suite of social media reforms on Sunday, saying families needed new ways to protect their children online. Continue reading...

title.en: Israel clears way for crocodiles to stop prison breaks
title.zh: 以色列为使用鳄鱼阻止越狱开绿灯

summary.en: Israel's environment minister has reclassified crocodiles, allowing them to be used for security purposes. This decision follows reports that far-right Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir intends to use the animals to surround a prison holding Hamas militants.
summary.zh: 以色列环境部长已将鳄鱼重新归类，允许其用于安全目的。此前有报道称，极右翼安全部长伊塔马尔·本-格维尔计划利用这些动物围困关押哈马斯武装分子的监狱。

body.en:
Israel's environment minister has reclassified crocodiles so that they can now be used for security purposes. Far-right Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir reportedly wants them to surround a jail holding Hamas militants.

Israel's Environmental Protection Minister Idit Silman has given a new classification to crocodiles, in a move that may allow the reptiles to be deployed for security tasks, such as maintaining security at prisons.

The country's far-right national security minister, Itamar Ben-Gvir , reportedly in December proposed using crocodiles around a prison for Palestinian detainees, similar to a US migrant detention center in Florida dubbed  "Alligator Alcatraz."

The new classification puts the crocodiles in the category of "cultivated wild animal" instead of wild animals. It could allow an approved security organization to keep Nile crocodiles for security purposes, subject to government approval and conditions set by environmental authorities.

Israeli media reported that Ben-Gvir intends to use crocodiles to guard Ketziot prison in southern Israel, which primarily holds Palestinian security prisoners.

In a Facebook post on Thursday, Ben-Gvir wrote: "Are you thinking of attempting to escape? Think again." He accompanied the post with an AI-generated image of himself with a crocodile on a leash.

Israel's Channel 13 reported that the Israel Nature and Parks Authority spoke out against Ben-Gvir's proposal when he first put forward the idea last year.

The authority said wild animals should be kept only for research and educational reasons.

It also cited previous problems with bred crocodiles escaping into the wilderness and posing risks to human lives.

Channel 13 also said the idea "met with ridicule by several officers" at the Israel Prison Service.

body.zh: 以色列环境部长对鳄鱼进行了重新分类，以便它们现在可以用于安全目的。据报道，极右翼安全部长伊塔马尔·本-格维尔希望他们包围关押哈马斯武装分子的监狱。 以色列环境保护部长伊迪特·西尔曼对鳄鱼进行了新的分类，此举可能允许将爬行动物部署到安全任务中，例如维护监狱的安全。 据报道，该国极右翼国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本-格维尔 (Itamar Ben-Gvir) 去年 12 月提议在佛罗里达州美国移民拘留中心周围关押巴勒斯坦被拘留者的监狱周围使用鳄鱼，该监狱被称为“鳄鱼恶魔岛”。 新的分类将鳄鱼归入“养殖野生动物”类别，而不是野生动物。它可以允许经批准的安全组织出于安全目的饲养尼罗河鳄鱼，但须经政府批准和环境部门设定的条件。 以色列媒体报道称，本-格维尔打算用鳄鱼看守以色列南部的凯齐奥特监狱，该监狱主要关押巴勒斯坦安全囚犯。 本-格维尔周四在脸书上发帖写道：“你想尝试逃跑吗？再想想。”他在帖子中附上了一张由人工智能生成的照片，照片中他拴着一条鳄鱼。 以色列第 13 频道报道称，当本-格维尔去年首次提出这一想法时，以色列自然和公园管理局曾公开反对他的提议。 当局表示，野生动物的饲养只能用于研究和教育目的。 它还提到了此前饲养的鳄鱼逃入荒野并对人类生命构成威胁的问题。 第 13 频道还表示，这个想法“遭到了以色列监狱管理局几名官员的嘲笑”。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，将我们选为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

Proverbs 28:15 reminds us that a ruler who governs with such harshness, like a "roaring lion or a ranging bear," reflects a troubling approach to authority. title.en: US and Iran exchange strikes after two US soldiers killed in Jordan
title.zh: 美国和伊朗在两名美军士兵在约旦遇害后交换打击

summary.en: US forces have targeted Iranian sites for the eighth consecutive night, following an attack that killed two US soldiers in Jordan. Iran has responded by claiming it fired drones at US military targets in Kuwait, marking an escalation in regional tensions.
summary.zh: 在两名美国士兵在约旦遇害后，美军已连续第八晚袭击伊朗目标。伊朗则声称向科威特境内的美军发射了无人机，标志着地区紧张局势的升级。

body.en:
The US launched another round of air strikes against Iran on Saturday night, targeting its coastal surveillance and air defence facilities, US military officials said.

US Central Command (Centcom) said forces successfully hit Iranian military capabilities, while Iranian state media said Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz had been struck.

Centcom said it also targeted Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) responsible for the attack that killed two US troops in Jordan on Friday, where another service member remains missing.

In response to the latest strikes, Iran's army said it carried out drone attacks on two US bases in Kuwait, according to state media.

The US and Iran have ramped up attacks against each other in recent days, with both sides accused of striking critical infrastructure.

On Saturday, Iran said it carried out "large-scale attacks with kamikaze drones" against an American military "depot at Camp Udairi" and another at "Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait", according to the IRGC-affiliated Tasnim news agency.

The US strikes, on the eighth successive night of attacks, were "designed to further degrade Iran's ability to threaten commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz", Centcom said.

The strikes were to "swiftly punish Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps forces who launched attacks against American service members in Jordan last night," the statement continued.

It followed a week of renewed hostilities in which Washington reimposed its blockade of Iranian ports and Tehran declared the Strait of Hormuz closed, as their preliminary ceasefire collapsed less than a month after it began.

In a statement earlier on Saturday, Centcom said: "Two US service members in Jordan were killed in action as US Central Command (Centcom) and partner forces defended against Iranian ballistic missile and drone attacks. Additionally, one service member is currently missing."

US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth responded to the deaths with a post on X that said: "Godspeed, heroes. Their sacrifice only stiffens our resolve."

The US death toll in the conflict has now risen to 16 after an American Navy pilot who went missing earlier this month was declared dead, marking the second increase in the toll this week.

In Iran, at least 50 people have been killed and more than 500 injured in US strikes over the past three weeks, the country's health ministry said.

title.en: Russia's largest ballistic assault of war rocks Kyiv
title.zh: 俄罗斯对基辅发动了战争中最大规模的弹道导弹袭击

summary.en: Fires erupted across Kyiv following Russia's most extensive ballistic missile attack of the war, causing injuries to several people in the Ukrainian capital.

body.en:
Fires broke out across the Ukrainian capital after Russia's latest missile attack, which used the highest number of ballistic missiles of the war so far. Several people have been injured in Kyiv.

Russia  launched a major overnight missile attack on Ukraine ’s capital, Kyiv, involving ballistic missiles, Ukrainian officials said.

Moscow launched the largest number of ballistic missiles — around four dozen — ‌in ⁠a ⁠single attack since the ​start of its full-scale war, ​Kyiv's acting foreign ​minister ‌said on Sunday.

"We urge ​appropriate ⁠and strong responses. We ⁠need devastating ​pressure on Moscow to end this terror," Andrii Sybiha ‌wrote on X.

At least one person was killed and 16 others injured, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenksyy wrote on X, reiterating the country's need for anti-ballistic interceptors.

"Protection against ballistic missiles is our constant and top priority right now. Interceptors are needed every day, and I am grateful to everyone who takes our agreements seriously and ensures the delivery of anti-ballistic capabilities," he said. 

The attack began at around 1:30 a.m. local time (22:30 GMT, Saturday), continued for several hours.

Ukrainian air defenses shot down 18 ‌out ⁠of ⁠41 missiles launched ​by Russia overnight, according to ​Kyiv's air force. It said 23 ‌missiles and 10 ‌drones ​had hit 20 locations during the ​attack, which was aimed ⁠primarily ​at Kyiv. 

Witnesses on the ground reported hearing several explosions, including those from air defense systems. An AFP journalist reported that one of the explosions was so powerful that it set off car alarms across the city center. 

Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said several fires had been reported across the city in residential and non-residential areas. Fires broke out at a dormitory, a residential block and at a supermarket, he said in a series of posts on Telegram, adding that emergency services had been deployed.

Rescue workers pulled four people from a burning private home in the Sviatoshynskyi district, while in the Shevchenkivskyi district they rescued residents from a burning three-story building.

Russia's latest strikes come a day after Ukraine sent attack drones to destroy e-commerce warehouses in the Moscow and Tambov regions, killing at least eight people and causing major fires. On the same day, Russian strikes killed at least two people in Ukraine. 

Both sides have regularly resorted to drone strikes , but Moscow is increasingly using ballistic missiles aimed at Kyiv and other locations across Ukraine. That's at a time when Kyiv has warned of dwindling stocks of interceptor missiles used to block Russian ballistic missiles.

title.en: Influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate arrested in US on new charges, face extradition
title.zh: 网红安德鲁·泰特和特里斯坦·泰特在美国因新指控被捕，面临引渡

summary.en: Influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate have been arrested in the US on new charges and are now facing extradition to the United Kingdom.

body.en:
Radical social media influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate have been arrested in the United States as British authorities seek their extradition on rape and sex trafficking charges.

The brothers' social media empire promoting wealth, male dominance and misogyny has made them among the world's most polarising internet personalities.

The US Marshals Service confirmed the arrest of 39-year-old Andrew Tate, a self-professed misogynist, and his younger brother on a sealed warrant, placing the US at the centre of an international legal saga that has stretched from Romania to Britain.

US news outlet TMZ posted a video of law enforcement officers placing the men in handcuffs and escorting them into waiting vehicles. Asked by an onlooker if he had something to say, Tristan Tate did not respond, the footage posted on social media platform X showed.

British prosecutors said on Sunday they were prosecuting Andrew Tate with seven further counts of rape, three counts of facilitating trafficking for sexual exploitation, three counts of assault and 19 additional charges for offences relating to indecent images of a child and extreme pornography. He has already been charged previously for 10 counts of rape, assault and human trafficking.

Tristan Tate had been charged with an six more counts of sexual assault, rape and facilitating trafficking for sexual exploitation. He already has 11 previous charges for the same crimes.

British prosecutors seeking the brothers' extradition alleging they conducted these offences between 2010 and 2017.

They were arrested there in 2022, accused of participating in schemes to lure women for sexual exploitation. They denied those allegations and the case didn't go forward because of legal and procedural irregularities.

The pending charges in the United Kingdom accused the brothers of abusing women in an area north of London, where they grew up. Their lawyers had said they denied the allegations.

Joseph McBride, a lawyer representing the Tate brothers, said in a phone interview he had not been able to speak with his clients but called the new charges out of the UK "filth and slander" intended to derail defamation lawsuits filed by the brothers in the US.

"They're pulling out all the stops to make sure these guys never get their day in court," McBride said.

"We are confident that once a competent judge sees the facts, and once the Department of Justice confronts this egregious abuse of its own authority, Andrew and Tristan Tate will walk free. America does not do Britain's political dirty work."

summary.en: The United States has launched new strikes on Iran following an Iranian attack that killed two US soldiers. This escalation has led to further casualties, with both nations continuing to target the Strait of Hormuz.

The United States said it had completed an eighth straight night of attacks against Iran after earlier announcing that two US military personnel were killed in Jordan and another was missing following an Iranian attack.

The US and Iran have intensified ‌attacks since an interim ceasefire deal signed a month ago fell apart last week, raising the possibility of a return to all-out war.

US Central Command said in a statement that the strikes were "designed to further degrade Iran's ability to threaten commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and swiftly punish Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps forces who launched attacks against American service members in Jordan last night".

Central Command later said it had completed its wave of attacks, hitting Iranian military coastal surveillance and air defence facilities.

Iran's Mehr news agency said the US carried out an attack near Sirik in southern Iran, adding that no casualties or damage to infrastructure have been reported. The Tasnim news agency said the US military also targeted a location near Shadegan, close to the border with Iraq.

title.en: Germany: CDU's Jens Spahn resigns amid surrogacy controversy
title.zh: 德国：基民盟的延斯·施潘因代孕争议辞职

summary.en: Jens Spahn, a prominent member of Germany's conservative Christian Democratic Union (CDU), has resigned from a party leadership role. His resignation follows controversy over his decision to have a child with his husband via a surrogate mother in the US, a practice not permitted in Germany and opposed by the CDU.
summary.zh: 德国保守派基督教民主联盟（CDU）的杰斯·施潘辞去党内领导职务。此前，他与丈夫在美国通过代孕母亲育有一子，而代孕在德国不被允许，也遭到基民盟的反对，此事引发了争议。

body.zh: 德国不允许代孕，保守的基督教民主联盟（CDU）也反对代孕合法化。斯潘和他的丈夫通过美国的代孕母亲生下了他们的孩子。 联邦议院执政保守派集团的议会领袖延斯·斯潘 (Jens Spahn) 于周六辞职，原因是他通过代孕生孩子的决定引发争议。 保守派基督教民主党（CDU）总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨（Friedrich Merz）要求辞职。 德国不允许代孕，基民盟反对代孕合法化。斯潘和他的丈夫通过美国的代孕母亲生下了他们的孩子。 斯潘在新闻机构看到的一份声明中说：“最近几天，我开始意识到，我与丈夫组建家庭并成为一名父亲的个人幸福感与我的政治职责是不相容的。” 消息公布后，默茨总理表示这是“正确”的决定，并补充说斯潘下台是“不可避免的”。 梅尔茨接着解释说，他现在将与基民盟巴伐利亚姊妹党基督教社会联盟 (CSU) 的领导人马库斯·索德 (Markus Söder) 合作，提出新议会小组主席的提案。 “程序和时间表现在将与党和议会小组委员会协调，”他说。 本周早些时候，45 岁的 Spahn 和他的丈夫 Daniel Funke 宣布他们已经成为父母，并在社交媒体上发布了一张推着婴儿车的照片。 这一消息立即引起了德国政界各方的批评，他们指责斯潘采取双重标准，因为他在一个支持在德国境内使用代孕母亲的法律禁令的政党中担任高级职务。 在周五接受德国《图片报》播客采访时，斯潘试图为自己的决定辩护，称他“与自己斗争了很长时间，包括在代孕问题上”。 斯潘在德国不会因为通过代孕生孩子而面临法律后果，因为在德国抚养代孕母亲在国外出生的孩子并不违法。 这并不是斯潘第一次面临争议。作为新冠疫情时期的德国卫生部长，斯潘因涉嫌滥用公共资金而受到调查。 然而，州检察官于三月份放弃了对他在新冠病毒时期的交易的调查。 斯潘被视为保守派集团中的后起之秀，5 月份以 85% 的得票率再次当选议会党团领袖。

reflection.en: In a world grappling with complex ethical questions surrounding family formation, this story highlights the tension between personal choices and public policy. Regardless of the methods by which children come into our lives, Yahweh's Word reminds us that children are a precious gift and a blessing.
reflection.zh: 在一个努力应对围绕家庭组建的复杂伦理问题的世界里，这个故事凸显了个人选择与公共政策之间的张力。无论孩子以何种方式来到我们生命中，雅伟的话语提醒我们，孩子是宝贵的礼物和祝福。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: Norway: Huge fire destroys 100 homes, sparks evacuations
title.zh: 挪威：大火烧毁百栋房屋，引发疏散

summary.en: A large fire in Drammen, Norway, destroyed 100 homes and necessitated evacuations. Firefighters from across the country were called in to assist in battling the blaze.
summary.zh: 挪威德拉门市发生一场大火，烧毁了100栋房屋，并引发了疏散。来自挪威其他地区的消防员被调来协助扑灭大火。

body.en:
Firefighters from other areas of Norway were drafted in to help tackle the blaze in the southern city of Drammen.

A fire that broke out in a townhouse in southern Norway before destroying a hundred homes has been mostly brought under control, fire officials said Saturday.

Local media described the blaze as the largest in the Nordic nation for more than a century.

The fire on the outskirts of the city of Drammen, about 34 kilometers (21 miles) from Oslo, broke out around 3:30 p.m. local time (1330 UTC/GMT) on Friday, before ripping through a row of townhouses.

It then quickly spread through the neighborhood and toward nearby forests due to strong winds and exceptionally dry conditions, officials said.

Public broadcaster NRK said firefighters were brought in from several districts to work through the night to try to bring the blaze under control.

Several helicopters used to extinguish forest fires were also deployed, local media reported.

By Saturday lunchtime, Aftenposten  cited officials as saying there was no longer a major risk of the fire spreading within residential areas, but that firefighters hadn't yet gained control over forested areas. 

No deaths were reported, police said, but one firefighter was slightly injured and several people were treated for smoke inhalation.

Newspaper Dagbladet reported that the scene resembles a war zone, with burned-out cars and burned-down houses. 

Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store sent his condolences to those who lost their homes in the fire.

"My thoughts also go out to the fire and rescue crews and volunteers who are now taking part in the very demanding extinguishing work and are doing all they can to prevent the fire from spreading," he wrote on social media.

Officials say while the dry conditions may have helped the blaze to spread quickly, they don't yet know what caused the initial fire.

body.zh: 来自挪威其他地区的消防员被征召来帮助扑灭南部城市德拉门的大火。 消防官员周六表示，挪威南部一栋联排别墅发生的大火烧毁了一百所房屋，目前已基本得到控制。 当地媒体称这场火灾是北欧国家一个多世纪以来最严重的火灾。 距离奥斯陆约 34 公里（21 英里）的德拉门市郊区，火灾于下午 3:30 左右爆发。当地时间周五（1330 UTC/GMT），然后穿过一排联排别墅。 官员们表示，由于强风和异常干燥的条件，病毒随后迅速蔓延到整个社区，并向附近的森林蔓延。 公共广播公司 NRK 表示，消防员从多个地区赶来，彻夜工作，试图控制火势。 据当地媒体报道，还部署了几架用于扑灭森林火灾的直升机。 截至周六午餐时间，《晚邮报》援引官员的话称，住宅区内火灾蔓延的重大风险已不再存在，但消防队员尚未控制森林地区。 警方称，没有人员死亡的报道，但一名消防员受轻伤，多人因吸入烟雾而接受治疗。 据《每日新闻报》报道，现场就像战区一样，有被烧毁的汽车和被烧毁的房屋。 乔纳斯·加尔·斯托总理向在火灾中失去家园的人们表示哀悼。 他在社交媒体上写道：“我也关心消防救援人员和志愿者，他们现在正在参加非常艰巨的灭火工作，并正在尽一切努力阻止火势蔓延。” 官员们表示，虽然干燥的天气可能导致火势迅速蔓延，但他们还不知道最初起火的原因。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处将我们选为您在 Google 上的首选新闻来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The devastation of a large fire, destroying homes and displacing families, brings immense suffering. Yet, even in such trials, Yahweh's presence can cultivate endurance and character within us. As communities begin the long process of recovery, we hold onto the hope that emerges from perseverance.
reflection.zh: 大火摧毁房屋、使家庭流离失所，带来了巨大的痛苦。然而，即使在这样的考验中，雅伟的同在也能在我们里面培养忍耐和品格。当社区开始漫长的恢复过程时，我们紧紧抓住从坚韧中产生的盼望。

verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: DFAT making urgent inquiries after Australian tackled and handcuffed by ICE at US airport
title.zh: 澳大利亚外交贸易部就澳公民在美国机场被ICE制服并戴手铐一事紧急调查

summary.en: Australia's Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade is making urgent inquiries after an Australian citizen was reportedly tackled and handcuffed by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) at a US airport. The department stated it would offer consular assistance to any Australian citizen who requests it.

body.en:
Australia is making urgent inquiries with US immigration officials after an Australian man was tackled and handcuffed at Las Vegas airport.

Video of two Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents tackling Phu Nyuyen at Harry Reid International Airport has sparked public outrage and criticism from elected officials in the United States.

One video posted on social media showed a man yelling and crying on the ground while a man and a masked woman — both in plain clothes — try to control, handcuff and detain him.

When the pair realise they are being filmed, they walk away, leaving the man with a handcuff attached to one arm.

Late on Monday afternoon, the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police identified the pair as ICE agents.

They found no outstanding warrants on him, removed his handcuffs, and notified ICE.

According to the Department of Homeland Security, ICE officers did not proceed with the arrest of Phu Nguyen, a 57-year-old citizen of Australia who overstayed a visa that expired in 2015, at Las Vegas airport on Monday.

ICE arrested him at his flight departing the Los Angeles International Airport on Tuesday, "despite attempts by agitators to help him evade ICE officers at Las Vegas airport", the department said.

Nyugen is being held at the Adelanto ICE Processing Center in California, according to US media reports.

The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade said it was making urgent inquiries following reports of an Australian citizen detained in the US.

"The department stands ready to provide consular assistance to any Australian citizen, should it be requested," a spokesperson said.

The incident again put ICE's ‌aggressive tactics under scrutiny after an immigration officer on Monday killed a driver in a town in Maine .

"ICE is continuing to act with impunity — instilling fear in our communities and scaring tourists, which hurts our tourism economy," Democratic US senator for Nevada Jacky Rosen said following the aborted arrest at Las Vegas airport.

"Enough is enough. ICE must follow the same commonsense guardrails as other law enforcement agencies."

The Nevada Latino Legislative Caucus and the Asian American Native Hawaiian Pacific Islander Caucus are calling for a full investigation, urging Governor Joe Lombardo to explain the transparency and accountability for federal law enforcement agencies operating in Nevada.

reflection.zh: 这起事件提醒我们，个人在异国他乡面对国家权力时是多么脆弱。雅伟古老的诫命要求我们善待寄居者，如同本地人一样，这呼吁我们维护所有人的尊严和正当程序，不分国籍。它强调了在每一次互动中，怜悯和公平的重要性。

title.en: Laos says lack of autopsies means cause of tourist deaths cannot be proven as methanol
title.zh: 老挝称缺乏尸检，无法证明游客死因是甲醇

summary.en: Laos officials state that the cause of tourist deaths cannot be definitively proven as methanol due to the absence of autopsies. Individuals have been indicted on charges related to selling food harmful to health and operating an illegal business.
summary.zh: 老挝官员表示，由于缺乏尸检，无法证实游客死亡的原因是甲醇。涉案人员被控销售有害健康的食品和非法经营。

body.en:
Laos authorities said on Saturday they could not determine blame or the cause of the deaths in 2024 of six tourists previously linked to methanol-tainted alcohol because their families had refused to allow autopsies.

Two Danish citizens, an American, a Briton and two Australian teenagers died following what media reports said was a night out on the town in Vang Vieng in November that year.

"To date, authorities do not yet have evidence that can establish whether the deaths ... were caused by the actions of any individual or by any particular causes," the Laos Ministry of Public Security said in a statement on Saturday.

"This is because the authorities were not permitted to conduct autopsies on the bodies of the deceased, and therefore lacked the forensic evidence necessary to determine the cause of death," it said.

However, the statement said: "The Ministry of Health's Food and Drug Research Center found excessive levels of methanol in Tiger Vodka."

Methanol is a toxic alcohol that can be added to liquor to increase its potency but can cause blindness, liver damage and death.

The statement said, based on information provided by the Australian Embassy and a Thai hospital, that "methanol had been detected in the blood of the two deceased Australian tourists".

It said legal proceedings had been initiated against the owner of the Tiger distillery for "manufacturing or selling products hazardous to health" and "illegal commercial operation".

In a statement issued earlier on Saturday, Denmark's Ministry of Foreign Affairs confirmed that charges had been officially laid by Laos officials on Friday.

If found guilty, the accused faced up to four years' jail and a fine, Denmark's foreign ministry said.

The owner and 10 employees of the hostel where the American tourist was staying have also been charged with "destruction of evidence" after transporting his body to hospital.

The investigation has been a source of contention between Australia and Laos and the charges laid this weekend came amid concern over whether justice would be served nearly two years after the deaths of Bianca Jones and Holly Morton-Bowles.

"The Australian Government is deeply frustrated and bitterly disappointed that authorities in Laos are not pursuing the most serious charges," Foreign Minister Penny Wong said on Friday .

title.en: Trump, not Iran, is the world’s greatest danger. He’s a one-man weapon of mass destruction | Simon Tisdall
title.zh: 特朗普，而非伊朗，是世界上最大的危险。他是一个人的大规模杀伤性武器 | 西蒙·蒂斯代尔

summary.en: The article argues that the US president's actions have initiated a disastrous war and an economic quagmire, leading to a "limitless fiasco" as bombing resumes. It characterizes the president as "feckless and clueless," unable to navigate or exit the conflict he started.
summary.zh: 文章指出，随着轰炸再次开始，美国总统的行为已将美国拖入一场无止境的灾难和经济泥潭。文章形容这位总统“无能又糊涂”，无法摆脱他所发动的这场灾难性战争。

body.en: As the bombing starts again, it’s clear the president has dragged the US into a limitless fiasco – and the world into an economic quagmire Feckless and clueless, Donald Trump is lost in Iran, unable to find a way out of the disastrous war he started. Once again, the US military is pummelling the country and, increasingly, its civilian infrastructure. As before, this unlawful bludgeoning strengthens the resistance of a hardline regime that cares little for its people’s suffering. How often have Trump and Pete Hegseth, the Pentagon’s wildling lord of bones, hailed a bogus victory? The president claimed this week to be “winning big”. No one believes him. Even as it counts the vast human and economic cost of his Persian folly, a watching world scoffs at US impotence. Control of the strait of Hormuz, closed due to Trump’s belligerence, is now the White House’s limited, elusive objective. The grander US and Israeli war aims – eliminating Iran’s nuclear programme, degrading its regional militias, regime change – are less attainable than ever. It’s Trump’s craven leadership that renders US forces ineffective, not the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. If Iran really is the existential menace he claims, the logical course would be all-out conquest. When George W Bush decided Iraq posed unacceptable dangers, he invaded with 170,000 ground troops. It was a catastrophe. But at least Bush had balls. Simon Tisdall is a Guardian foreign affairs commentator Continue reading...
body.zh: 随着轰炸再次开始，很明显，总统已将美国拖入了无限的惨败 — — 并将世界拖入了经济泥潭。 无能又无能的唐纳德·特朗普在伊朗迷失了方向，无法找到摆脱他发起的灾难性战争的出路。美国军队再次对该国进行打击，并越来越多地打击其民用基础设施。和以前一样，这种非法的殴打加强了一个不关心人民苦难的强硬政权的抵抗。特朗普和五角大楼的野人骸骨领主皮特·赫格斯多少次欢呼一场虚假的胜利？总统本周声称“大获全胜”。没有人相信他。尽管他的波斯愚蠢行为造成了巨大的人力和经济成本，但全世界都在嘲笑美国的无能。控制因特朗普的好战而关闭的霍尔木兹海峡，现在已成为白宫有限且难以捉摸的目标。美国和以色列更宏伟的战争目标——消除伊朗核计划、削弱其地区民兵、政权更迭——比以往任何时候都更难以实现。导致美军效率低下的是特朗普胆怯的领导，而不是伊斯兰革命卫队。如果伊朗确实是他所声称的生存威胁，那么合乎逻辑的路线将是全面征服。当乔治·W·布什认定伊拉克构成了无法接受的危险时，他派遣了 17 万地面部队入侵。这是一场灾难。但至少布什有胆量。西蒙·蒂斯达尔是卫报外交事务评论员继续阅读...

reflection.en: This proverb reminds us of the profound and often devastating impact that leaders can have on their people and the world. When those in power act recklessly or without wisdom, the consequences can be like a destructive force, leaving nations in turmoil and people vulnerable. It underscores the heavy responsibility of leadership and the need for discernment...

title.en: Beijing’s message to the world’s tourists: come here and judge China for yourselves | Zichen Wang
title.zh: 北京向世界游客发出信息：来中国，亲自评判

summary.en: Beijing has relaxed its visa rules, aiming to boost its economy and enhance its international image. The move has led to a noticeable return of foreign tourists to the capital, engaging in sightseeing and local activities.
summary.zh: 北京放宽了签证规定，旨在提振经济并改善其国际形象。此举已使外国游客明显回流首都，他们正在观光并参与当地活动。

body.en: By relaxing visa rules, Beijing has two things on its mind – boosting its economy and improving its self-image Walk through central Beijing today and one thing quickly becomes apparent: foreigners are back. They are taking photos outside the Forbidden City and sitting in cafes around Gulou and Sanlitun. The shift is visible online, too; YouTube is increasingly filled with videos titled “China Shocked Me” or “My First Week in China”. Most of the creators are tourists, not China specialists or journalists, and many of them are encountering the country for the first time. The resurgence is striking because to many outside observers China’s story has become one of closure and increased security – of intensifying strategic rivalry with the west, expanded anti-espionage enforcement and increasingly constrained foreign reporting, including the withholding and revocation of visas for US journalists. Yet on the ground, another story is unfolding. When it comes to its relationship with the rest of the world, Beijing increasingly appears to be betting on direct exposure: come to China and judge for yourself. Zichen Wang is deputy secretary-general at the Center for China and Globalization, a thinktank in Beijing. title.en: 'Shocking vulnerabilities': Trump makes sweeping claims China meddled in US elections
title.zh: “令人震惊的漏洞”：特朗普就中国干预美国大选发表全面声明

summary.en: The US president made broad election security claims, laying groundwork for the federal government to take action.

body.en:
In a speech attacking US election integrity on Friday, US President Donald Trump released intelligence that he said showed major Chinese interference in US elections, reviving his false claims he won the 2020 election.

Trump's allegations about the "shocking vulnerabilities" in the American electoral system appeared to lay the groundwork for the Republican to dispute the results of November's crucial US midterm elections .

It underscored Trump's effort to make election security a central political issue ahead of November's midterm vote, when Republicans in Congress will face the prospect of losing control of both the House of Representatives and Senate — an outcome that would carry significant political consequences for Trump.

"We can never watch a stolen election again," Trump said in the primetime address, referencing his 2020 presidential election defeat by Democrat Joe Biden.

Trump said he was declassifying huge amounts of intelligence data that showed, among other things, that superpower rival China had illicitly acquired 220 million US voter files.

"Over a period of years, starting during the 2020 election cycle, the People's Republic of China carried out what is believed to be the largest compromise of election data in history," Trump said in the televised speech from the White House.

He asserted that members of the US intelligence community deliberately suppressed information about the extent of China's activities.

His allegations contradict an unclassified 2021 US intelligence community assessment that found no indications any foreign actor tried to alter or succeeded in altering "any technical aspect" of the 2020 presidential election vote.

The assessment was conducted under John Ratcliffe, then Trump's director of national intelligence and now his CIA director.

Trump also claimed there were more than 250,000 non-US citizens registered to vote in four states.

Trump has persistently claimed his 2020 election defeat was "rigged," although more than 60 lawsuits produced no ruling establishing fraud capable of changing the outcome, while recounts, audits and his own justice department found none.

After railing against election security in the 25-minute address, Trump pressed Republicans in Congress to pass his signature elections legislation, the SAVE America Act, which has been stalled for months.

It seeks to impose new voter identification and citizenship requirements, despite longstanding findings that voter fraud in US elections is rare.

Election security experts have said these measures would make it harder for millions of eligible voters to cast a ballot.

title.en: Hanson tells UK conservative conference audience to 'not apologise for being white'
title.zh: 汉森在英国保守党会议上呼吁听众“不要为自己是白人而道歉”

summary.en: One Nation Party leader Pauline Hanson addressed a conservative conference in the UK, urging attendees “not to apologise for being white.” She also stated that the UK was experiencing significant migration problems, similar to issues she observed in Australia.

body.en:
Don't apologise for being white, Pauline Hanson has said at a conservative conference in London amid a backdrop of growing backlash over her comments on migration and transgender rights.

Speaking at the Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC) on Saturday morning UK time, the One Nation leader told a sparse crowd that Australia had been "flooded" with migrants and gone "completely woke" over transgender rights.

Her speech capped a high-profile European trip that included a podcast interview with English anti-immigration activist and convicted criminal Tommy Robinson and an appearance at the Dolce & Gabbana fashion show in Italy with billionaire One Nation donor Gina Rinehart.

"I'm getting feedback from Australia, from the media, saying, 'How dare I associate with Tommy Robinson, how dare I speak to him,'" Hanson told a conference room that, judging by footage posted online, looked less than one-third full.

Hanson also said Australia was "too stupid" to get its laws around discrimination against transgender people right and praised a UK court decision that ruled the legal definition of a woman depended on their biological sex .

"There's going to be so much psychological damage that's going to be done to our future generations," she said.

Hanson had already come under fire in Australia earlier in the week for her interview with Robinson, in which she pointed to the scrapping of the White Australia policy as the root cause of migration issues in the country.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese addressed those comments on Saturday, saying it was important to remember that the racially discriminatory immigration policy was dismantled by both sides of politics and challenged the Opposition leader to rule out any future political deals with One Nation.

Hanson later released a video on social media saying allegations that she wanted to reintroduce the White Australia policy were false. "Never, ever have I advocated that, and I don't believe in that," she said.

"Yes, I've been strong on immigration. Bringing the right people into the country in a measured way and people who want to assimilate and be Australians."

Other speakers at the London CPAC event included Nationals senator Bridget McKenzie, Reform UK leader Nigel Farage and short-lived former Tory prime minister Liz Truss.

After an earlier meeting with Farage fell over due to his resignation from the UK parliament to re-contest his seat , Hanson and the Reform leader met briefly on the sidelines of the conference.

title.en: Sydney family embrace divided loyalties ahead of Argentina-Spain World Cup showdown
title.zh: 悉尼家庭在阿根廷-西班牙世界杯对决前拥抱“分裂的忠诚”

summary.en: A Sydney family with Spanish and Argentinian heritage is looking forward to the World Cup final, which will feature both nations, creating a fun atmosphere of friendly competition within their household.
summary.zh: 一个拥有西班牙和阿根廷血统的悉尼家庭正期待着世界杯决赛，这场比赛将由这两个国家对阵，为他们的家庭带来友好的竞争和欢乐气氛。

body.en:
Whatever the result in the FIFA World Cup final, it will be a win-win for Sydney couple Sandra Hurtado and Fernando Travasso.

On Monday morning (AEST), Spaniard Hurtado will be wearing a La Roja jersey while her partner, Travasso, will be backing his native Argentina as the two sides meet at New York New Jersey Stadium.

Their three children — twins Sofia and Carla, 10, and Marco, 11 — have grown up with both cultures. While that makes for some divided loyalties in the household, their parents stress that there's no bad blood.

"For me, especially, it feels like the cup is already home because whoever wins doesn't matter for us," Hurtado told SBS News.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I just want both to win, and even if one of them loses, I think they can improve next time and get better," she said.

Hurtado and Travasso arrived in Australia in 2008 and have spent almost two decades building a life together while keeping their Spanish and Argentine traditions alive.

Travasso said the World Cup had become another way to stay connected to family on the other side of the world.

"We've been heavily involved in the community [and] integrated into Australian society, but we still manage to keep our identity and [pass on] the values and history of each of our cultures.

"Every day we have conversations with our relatives. When the World Cup comes ... and we have both countries together ... we're going to be using WhatsApp ... at the same time."

"Once we sit down there with our different T-shirts and all the things, I still think that would be a nice competition, it would be a little bit spicy, and we are going to have good fun," Travasso said.

"Spain has amazing football players, and we have amazing teams that are very good [in the European tournaments]."

She said that, before winning the World Cup in 2010, Spain had "never made it too far".

It would also be a second consecutive championship for Messi's side after their 2022 win — a feat that would make it the first nation to go back-to-back since Brazil in 1962.

"Through different cities in Argentina, you can find big murals or big paintings on the wall with [Lionel] Messi .

"A few memories that I have when I was little ... were a TV, white and black, with [Diego] Maradona playing."

Hurtado said she hopes her children take away something more important than the result.

"In life it's not about one person, it's about a team. When someone wins, it's not just the person who scores the goal; it's everybody working together towards the same goal.

summary.en: England defeated France 6-4 in a football match, overcoming a strong second-half comeback attempt by France. During the game, Kylian Mbappé achieved the milestone of becoming the World Cup's all-time top scorer.

body.en:
England have held off a remarkable French comeback to win the World Cup third-place playoff 6-4, securing their best finish at the tournament in 60 years.

England led 4-0 at half-time after a stunning opening 45 minutes that included a Bukayo Saka double and the Three Lions' second-fastest goal in World Cup history by Declan Rice.

But France mounted an extraordinary second-half fightback at Miami Stadium, scoring three goals in 18 minutes to cut the deficit to one.

Kylian Mbappé scored twice, becoming the highest goalscorer in World Cup history and moving ahead of Argentina's Lionel Messi in the Golden Boot race, a trophy awarded to the tournament's highest scorer.

Ezri Konsa doubled England's lead with a glancing header from a corner delivered by Rice in the 18th minute.

Saka, who had a goal ruled out for offside in the 12th minute, struck twice before the break. He netted from close range in the 37th minute before adding his second in first-half stoppage time to give England a stunning 4-0 lead at the interval.

France finally found a response three minutes into the second half when star forward Mbappé finished from close range.

Bradley Barcola then reduced the deficit to two in the 54th minute, hammering the ball past England goalkeeper Dean Henderson, who started in place of Jordan Pickford.

Mbappé's second goal in the 66th minute made him the outright leading scorer in World Cup history with 22 goals and moved him ahead of Messi in the Golden Boot standings, with 10 goals this tournament.

Messi, who is second with eight goals, will have the chance to reclaim the lead in Monday morning's final against Spain.

England restored their two-goal cushion when Saka completed his hat-trick with an 87th-minute penalty after Djed Spence was fouled in the box.

But France struck again in the sixth minute of stoppage time through Ousmane Dembélé to make it 5-4.

Jude Bellingham then sealed the result moments later with another goal, as England prevailed in a 10-goal thriller.

title.en: Australia's coal capital is preparing for what once seemed 'unimaginable'

summary.en: A once-in-a-lifetime change is taking place on the sites of old coal-fired power stations.

The high-pitched whirr of coal trains between Newcastle and Muswellbrook has been the backdrop to life in the NSW Hunter region for more than 100 years, but a new soundscape is set to take its place as the renewables transition gathers pace.

Earlier this year, the 169-metre-high chimneys of Muswellbrook's Liddell coal-fired power station were brought down in a controlled explosion, demolishing a structure that has greeted those entering the town, about 240km north-west of Sydney, for more than 50 years.

The change now taking place next to the former boilers of "old Lady Liddell", where a new kind of industrial activity can be heard, is largely hidden from passersby.

When SBS News visited the site on the shores of the picturesque Lake Liddell last month, long rows of pristine white cabinets had been installed, from which a dull drone could be heard.

They are part of the new Liddell Battery, which is due to be brought online within weeks.

The project is one of eight battery projects in the Hunter region that have been approved and are in various stages of construction across the council areas of Muswellbrook, Lake Macquarie, Newcastle City, Singleton, Port Stephens and Central Coast.

Two batteries — one of which is the most powerful in Australia — are already operational near Lake Macquarie.

Eight solar and wind projects have also been approved, with more in the pipeline.

The projects are set to change the nature of this region forever, and even supporters of coal mining acknowledge the future prosperity of the region may rely on this once-in-a-lifetime transition.

Muswellbrook mayor and former coal miner Jeffrey Drayton is among those acknowledging the shift.

He says the region is now attracting "extraordinary interest" from businesses due to the energy security on offer.

"I don't think there's been any form of renewable energy that's not proposed for Muswellbrook Shire," Drayton tells SBS News.

The mayor says there have been around 20 renewable energy projects proposed in the council area, including a 2.4-gigawatt (GW) battery, along with solar, hydro and wind projects.

With 4.8GW storage capacity and 2.4GW discharge capacity, the giant Denman battery near Muswellbrook could power more than one million homes — around a third of all households in the state — for roughly two hours if approved.

It's one of 13 battery projects currently undergoing planning assessment or consideration in the broader Hunter region, according to the NSW government. Two others are already operational,...

body.en:
Australia is making urgent inquiries with US immigration officials after an Australian man was tackled and handcuffed at Las Vegas airport.

Video of two Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents tackling Phu Nyuyen at Harry Reid International Airport has sparked public outrage and criticism from elected officials in the United States.

One video posted on social media showed a man yelling and crying on the ground while a man and a masked woman — both in plain clothes — try to control, handcuff and detain him.

When the pair realise they are being filmed, they walk away, leaving the man with a handcuff attached to one arm.

Late on Monday afternoon, the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police identified the pair as ICE agents.

They found no outstanding warrants on him, removed his handcuffs, and notified ICE.

According to the Department of Homeland Security, ICE officers did not proceed with the arrest of Phu Nguyen, a 57-year-old citizen of Australia who overstayed a visa that expired in 2015, at Las Vegas airport on Monday.

ICE arrested him at his flight departing the Los Angeles International Airport on Tuesday, "despite attempts by agitators to help him evade ICE officers at Las Vegas airport", the department said.

Nyugen is being held at the Adelanto ICE Processing Center in California, according to US media reports.

The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade said it was making urgent inquiries following reports of an Australian citizen detained in the US.

"The department stands ready to provide consular assistance to any Australian citizen, should it be requested," a spokesperson said.

The incident again put ICE's ‌aggressive tactics under scrutiny after an immigration officer on Monday killed a driver in a town in Maine .

"ICE is continuing to act with impunity — instilling fear in our communities and scaring tourists, which hurts our tourism economy," Democratic US senator for Nevada Jacky Rosen said following the aborted arrest at Las Vegas airport.

"Enough is enough. ICE must follow the same commonsense guardrails as other law enforcement agencies."

The Nevada Latino Legislative Caucus and the Asian American Native Hawaiian Pacific Islander Caucus are calling for a full investigation, urging Governor Joe Lombardo to explain the transparency and accountability for federal law enforcement agencies operating in Nevada.

title.en: Laos says lack of autopsies means cause of tourist deaths cannot be proven as methanol

summary.en: Laos officials state that the cause of tourist deaths cannot be definitively proven as methanol due to the absence of autopsies. Individuals have been indicted on charges related to selling food harmful to health and operating an illegal business.
summary.zh: 老挝官员表示，由于缺乏尸检，无法证实游客死亡的原因是甲醇。涉案人员被控销售有害健康的食品和非法经营。

body.en:
Laos authorities said on Saturday they could not determine blame or the cause of the deaths in 2024 of six tourists previously linked to methanol-tainted alcohol because their families had refused to allow autopsies.

Two Danish citizens, an American, a Briton and two Australian teenagers died following what media reports said was a night out on the town in Vang Vieng in November that year.

"To date, authorities do not yet have evidence that can establish whether the deaths ... were caused by the actions of any individual or by any particular causes," the Laos Ministry of Public Security said in a statement on Saturday.

"This is because the authorities were not permitted to conduct autopsies on the bodies of the deceased, and therefore lacked the forensic evidence necessary to determine the cause of death," it said.

However, the statement said: "The Ministry of Health's Food and Drug Research Center found excessive levels of methanol in Tiger Vodka."

In a statement issued earlier on Saturday, Denmark's Ministry of Foreign Affairs confirmed that charges had been officially laid by Laos officials on Friday.

If found guilty, the accused faced up to four years' jail and a fine, Denmark's foreign ministry said.

The owner and 10 employees of the hostel where the American tourist was staying have also been charged with "destruction of evidence" after transporting his body to hospital.

The investigation has been a source of contention between Australia and Laos and the charges laid this weekend came amid concern over whether justice would be served nearly two years after the deaths of Bianca Jones and Holly Morton-Bowles.

"The Australian Government is deeply frustrated and bitterly disappointed that authorities in Laos are not pursuing the most serious charges," Foreign Minister Penny Wong said on Friday .

title.en: FIFA World Cup 2026: Why England and France still have something to play for
title.zh: 2026年国际足联世界杯：为什么英格兰和法国仍有比赛的意义

summary.en: England and France are set to compete in the FIFA World Cup 2026 third-place playoff. Although neither team reached the final, the match still holds significance, with both sides having "plenty on the line."
summary.zh: 英格兰和法国将在2026年国际足联世界杯三四名决赛中对决。尽管两队都未能进入决赛，但这场比赛仍意义重大，双方都有“很多东西”值得争取。

body.en:
When England takes on France tomorrow, it won't be the World Cup fixture either side was hoping for.

After semi-final defeats to Argentina and Spain, the teams will meet at Miami Stadium at 7am Sunday (AEST) to decide who finishes third in this year's tournament.

"None of our players and none of the French players want to play this match," England coach Thomas Tuchel said.

The Independent's senior sports writer, Kieran Jackson, went further, calling on FIFA to scrap the "pointless" fixture, which is widely viewed as little more than a consolation prize.

Despite the disappointment of missing out on the final — which will be on Monday morning — the teams still have a few things to play for.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

For one, the Golden Boot is still up for grabs. The trophy is awarded to the player who scored the most goals in the tournament, with assists used as a tiebreaker.

Argentina's Lionel Messi currently leads the race with eight goals and four assists, while France's Kylian Mbappé is level on goals but trails with three assists.

England's Harry Kane and Jude Bellingham are also in contention, with six goals and one assist each.

While either player would need a remarkable hat-trick to overtake the front-runners, presuming they don't score, the chance to finish as the tournament's top scorer could provide extra motivation for the forwards to go on the attack.

The match will be Didier Deschamps' final game as France coach after 14 years in charge.

His tenure has included his side winning a World Cup title in 2018, a runner-up finish in 2022 and three consecutive semi-final appearances.

The match gives his players one final opportunity to send off the man who transformed France into one of international football's most consistent teams.

"We aren't headed to the match we were hoping for, but we still have a match to play and we have a duty to fulfil," Deschamps said ahead of the third-place playoff.

"When you wear the France shirt, it's not just about what you get, it's also about giving back. It's the standard I set for myself, for my staff and for the players too. We have a responsibility towards every France fan who has followed us and shared in our ups and downs."

For England, victory would secure their best World Cup finish since winning the tournament for the first and only time in 1966.

Since then, they have lost both of their previous third-place playoffs — against Italy in 1990 and Belgium in 2018.

France have enjoyed far greater recent success, winning the 2018 World Cup before finishing runners-up in 2022.
